app.shortcutDescription: WinMarchy: the Omarchy look for Windows, with GlazeWM
app.stillRunning: WinMarchy keeps running in the notification area. Win+Alt+P brings the window back.
app.confirmClose: A job is still running. Quitting now stops it halfway. Whatever it changed so far is in the restore point.

overview.title: Start
overview.subtitle: What is running, which theme is on and where you are working.
overview.notSetUpText: Setup gets GlazeWM and the other programs straight from their vendors, applies the theme and the shortcuts, and makes a restore point first.
overview.notSetUpLegacy: Winarchy Lite is already in use on this PC. Setup takes over its themes and wallpapers, stops the old shortcut script and removes its autostart entry. All of it can be undone.
overview.programsHint: Something missing? Setup downloads it straight from the vendor.
overview.workspaceHint: Win+Alt+L switches this workspace's layout, Win+K shows every shortcut.
overview.glazeHint: Without GlazeWM there is no tiling and no workspaces. Win+Shift+Alt+R starts it.

tools.lookup: Looking up the current version of {tool} …

setup.title: Setup
setup.subtitle: Run it once and Windows looks like Omarchy. A restore point comes first, and Undo takes you back at any time.
setup.programsText: Every program comes straight from the vendor's GitHub release and is checked before it is unpacked. Everything goes to C:\WinMarchy\Tools, no admin rights needed.

why.glazewm: Tiles the windows and runs the workspaces. Nothing works without it.
why.zebar: The top bar with workspaces, clock, network, sound and battery.
why.autohotkey: Catches the shortcuts, including the Win key on its own.
why.flow: The launcher behind Win+Space, like Walker in Omarchy.
why.pwsh: PowerShell 7 for the terminal. Windows only ships the old 5.1.
why.herdr: Terminal workspace for coding agents, Win+Ctrl+Enter. Still beta on Windows.
why.pi: The Pi coding agent in the terminal, Win+Alt+Enter.

setup.autostartHint: One entry in the Startup folder. WinMarchy then starts GlazeWM, the bar and the shortcuts.
setup.taskbarHint: The top bar takes over. The taskbar comes back when you quit WinMarchy.
setup.barHint: Workspaces, clock, network, sound and battery, like Waybar in Omarchy.
setup.wallpapersHint: All {count} pictures of the {themes} themes, about {size}. Every theme then has its pictures right away.
setup.startHint: Takes one to three minutes, depending on your connection.
setup.done: All set. Win+K shows every shortcut.
setup.extrasText: Not needed for the Omarchy desktop. You can also install them one by one later.
setup.piNeedsBash: Needs Git Bash, which is missing here.

themes.title: Themes
themes.subtitle: Omarchy's 22 themes. A theme colours GlazeWM, the bar, the terminal, VS Code, Flow Launcher and Windows.
themes.importTitle: Choose a folder with Omarchy themes
themes.importNone: The folder had no matching theme.
themes.credit: Themes from Omarchy {tag} · MIT, Copyright (c) David Heinemeier Hansson

hotkeys.title: Shortcuts
hotkeys.subtitle: Omarchy's shortcuts, moved to Windows. The Win key plays the part of Super.
hotkeys.engineAhkText: AutoHotkey catches every shortcut and passes window commands on to GlazeWM. This is the only way the Win key on its own can open the launcher.
hotkeys.engineGlazeText: GlazeWM catches the shortcuts itself. Meant for PCs where AutoHotkey is blocked. The Win key on its own and the mouse wheel do not work then.
hotkeys.ahkNotInstalled: AutoHotkey is not installed yet, GlazeWM fills in until it is.
hotkeys.winAlone: Win key on its own opens the launcher
hotkeys.winAloneHint: Like Super in Omarchy. Ctrl+Esc still opens the Start menu.
hotkeys.profilesText: Business is always on: Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Word and Copilot instead of HEY, Signal and Obsidian.
hotkeys.personalHint: Spotify, WhatsApp, Telegram and your shortcuts from bindings.lua.
hotkeys.ahkMissingFallback: AutoHotkey is missing, GlazeWM takes the shortcuts.
hotkeys.customUnreadable: Could not read your own shortcuts: {detail}

kindHints.wm: A GlazeWM command, e.g. focus --direction left. Separate several with ;.
kindHints.app: One of the programs WinMarchy knows.
kindHints.web: An https address. It opens in its own window, like Omarchy's web apps.
kindHints.open: For example ms-settings:display, mailto: or spotify:.
kindHints.send: Keys sent to the window in front, e.g. Ctrl+Shift+T.
kindHints.do: Menus, layouts, the scratchpad and other WinMarchy functions.
kindHints.run: Path to a script or program. %personal-script% stands for your script from the settings.

reserved.winL: Win+L always locks Windows and cannot be used.

errors.unknownModifier: “{modifier}” in “{combo}” is not a modifier. Use Win, Ctrl, Alt and Shift.
errors.unknownKey: WinMarchy does not know the key “{key}” in “{combo}”.
errors.needsModifier: “{combo}” needs a modifier, otherwise the key would be gone for typing.
errors.actionFormat: “{action}” is not in the form kind:value, e.g. app:terminal.
errors.wmVerb: “{verb}” is not a GlazeWM command WinMarchy allows.
errors.unknownApp: WinMarchy does not know the program “{app}”.
errors.duplicate: {keys} is bound twice. The last entry wins.
errors.wheelNeedsAhk: Mouse wheel shortcuts only work with AutoHotkey.

commands.move-window-monitor: Window to another monitor (left, right, up, down)

tiling.title: Tiling
tiling.subtitle: How GlazeWM arranges your windows. As in Omarchy, each workspace has its own layout.
tiling.defaultLayoutText: Used for new workspaces. Win+Alt+L switches the layout of the workspace you are on.
tiling.scrollingNote: Real scrolling, where windows run past the edge of the screen, is something GlazeWM cannot do. Columns is the closest.
tiling.notConnected: Your workspaces show up here once GlazeWM runs.
tiling.dimHint: Windows without focus become slightly see-through.
tiling.taskbarHint: Comes back as soon as you quit WinMarchy.
tiling.applyHint: Rewrites the GlazeWM config and reloads it. A restore point comes first.
tiling.splitNext: The split applies from the next window on.
tiling.minimizeHint: Omarchy has no minimizing. A minimized window disappears into the scratchpad, Win+S brings it back.
tiling.touchpadHint: Win+Ctrl+D gives every monitor a new workspace, Win+Ctrl+Arrow switches all of them together, like virtual desktops. Under “Advanced gestures” you can put the three-finger swipe on these shortcuts. Better not “Switch desktops”: Windows' virtual desktops do not get along with GlazeWM.

layouts.dwindleText: Each new window splits the space of the focused one. Omarchy's default.
layouts.columnsText: Windows side by side, equally wide. The closest thing to Omarchy's scrolling.
layouts.floatingText: Windows lie freely on top of each other.

scratchpad.stored: In the scratchpad. Win+S brings it back.
scratchpad.empty: The scratchpad is empty. Win+Alt+S puts a window in.

restore.title: Undo
restore.subtitle: Before WinMarchy changes anything, it saves the old state. Here you undo single changes or all of them.
restore.originalText: WinMarchy changed {count} things since {date}. This puts all of them back the way they were.
restore.nothingYet: WinMarchy has not changed anything yet.
restore.noTools: WinMarchy has not installed any programs.
restore.confirmAll: {count} files and settings go back to how they were before WinMarchy. The bar and the shortcut script stop, the taskbar comes back.
restore.confirmAllTools: The programs in C:\WinMarchy\Tools are deleted.
restore.allDone: Everything is back to how it was before WinMarchy.
restore.confirmPoint: “{title}” sets {count} files and settings back to how they were before.
restore.confirmDelete: “{title}” cannot be restored afterwards. The state before WinMarchy is kept.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved in {path}
settings.appearanceText: For this window. The accent colour comes from the active theme.
settings.languageHint: Takes effect the next time WinMarchy starts.
settings.prerelease: Test build, does not update itself
settings.autoUpdateHint: WinMarchy downloads new versions from GitHub, checks them and switches when the window is closed.
settings.personalScriptHint: Runs with Win+Ctrl+T when the Personal profile is on. PowerShell scripts run under the PC's execution policy.
settings.filesPathHint: Only needed when WinMarchy cannot find the file itself.
settings.herdrMissing: Not installed. Setup → Optional extras downloads Herdr for you. Without internet, pick the ZIP from herdr.dev here.
settings.unreadable: Could not read the settings, WinMarchy starts with the defaults: {detail}
settings.fileManagerText: Omarchy opens folders in Nautilus, WinMarchy in Files if you like. This PC, the recycle bin and the control panel stay with Explorer.
settings.filesDefault: Files as the default file manager
settings.filesDefaultHint: Folders, drives and Win+E open Files. Switching it off brings Explorer back, and so does Undo.
settings.filesDefaultMissing: Files is not installed. It is free in the Microsoft Store and at files.community.
settings.filesDefaultOn: Files is now the default file manager.
settings.filesDefaultOff: Explorer is the default file manager again.

log.title: Log
log.subtitle: What WinMarchy did. The files are in {path} and kept for 30 days.
log.policiesHint: Looks for group policies and Intune settings that override WinMarchy.

jobs.filesDefaultOn: Files as the default file manager
jobs.filesDefaultOff: Explorer as the default file manager

steps.allWallpapers: Download the wallpapers of all themes ({count})

powershell.blocked: The execution policy ({policy}) does not allow profiles. WinMarchy does not bypass it, PowerShell keeps its default colours.

vscode.installFailed: Could not install the extension {extension}. VS Code gets the colours through colorCustomizations instead.

flow.done: Flow Launcher has the “WinMarchy” theme and listens on Alt+F24.

files.notFound: Files is not installed, or its settings file is missing.
files.running: Files is open and would overwrite the colours when it closes. Close Files and apply the theme again.

windows.done: Windows is now {mode}, with the theme's accent colour.

wallpaper.unsupported: Windows cannot use {file} as a wallpaper.

lockScreen.failed: Could not set the lock screen: {detail}

filesDefault.on: Folders, drives and Win+E now open Files.
filesDefault.gone: Files is no longer installed. Folders open in Explorer again.

legacy.themesImported: {count} themes taken over from Winarchy Lite

actions.flowMissing: Flow Launcher is missing. Setup can install it.
actions.glazeMissing: GlazeWM is missing. Setup can install it.
actions.scriptMissing: No personal script set, or the file is gone. See Settings.

agent.started: WinMarchy {version} is running in the background
agent.glazeMissing: GlazeWM is not installed, tiling stays off.
agent.startFailed: Something went wrong while starting the programs: {detail}
agent.taskbarSettingOff: The taskbar is not hidden in the first place. Turn that on under Tiling.
agent.awakeOn: Staying awake. Screen and PC will not go to sleep.
agent.noWallpapers: No wallpapers downloaded for this theme yet.
agent.restored: Everything reset. WinMarchy stays in the notification area until you quit it.
agent.glazeConnectFailed: GlazeWM is running, but WinMarchy cannot reach it: {detail}

wallpaper.lockScreen: Use for the lock screen too
wallpaper.lockScreenDone: The lock screen now shows the same picture.
wallpaper.lockScreenFailed: Could not change the lock screen. See the log for details.

install.newerInstalled: C:\WinMarchy\App already has version {version}, starting that one instead.
install.noRights: No write access to {path}, WinMarchy runs portable: {detail}
install.locked: {path} is in use right now, WinMarchy runs from here: {detail}
install.notSingleFile: Developer build, WinMarchy runs from here.
install.prerelease: Test build {version}, runs from here and does not update itself.
install.shortcutFailed: Could not create a Start menu entry: {detail}

update.readyNotice: WinMarchy {version} is ready and installs on the next start.

net.githubRateLimit: GitHub is limiting requests right now. WinMarchy reads the release page directly instead.

errors.ahkInvalid: AutoHotkey rejected the script, the old one stays active: {detail}
errors.backupBlobMissing: The saved file {blob} is missing from the backup folder.
errors.backupDangerous: {path} is a system folder. WinMarchy does not restore it.
errors.herdrZipInvalid: The ZIP must contain exactly one herdr.exe.
errors.jsonNotObject: The file does not contain a JSON object.
errors.proxyAuth: the proxy wants you to sign in
errors.releaseTagUnknown: Could not find the current version of {repo}.
errors.restorePartial: {failed} entries could not be restored. The log has the details.
errors.shaMismatch: {file} is damaged or was changed (SHA-256 expected {expected}, got {actual}). The file was thrown away.
errors.toolAssetMissing: The {tool} release {tag} has no matching file.
errors.toolNoChecksum: GitHub publishes no checksum for {file} of {tool}. WinMarchy installs nothing it cannot check.
errors.toolNotFoundAfterInstall: {tool} cannot be found after installing it.
errors.toolNotInstallable: WinMarchy does not install {tool} itself. The link to the vendor is on Start.
errors.zipInvalidPath: The ZIP contains an invalid path: {entry}

policies.none: No policy found that affects WinMarchy.
policies.found: {count} policies affect WinMarchy. The list is here and in the log.

effects.wallpaper: IT sets the wallpaper ({value}). Windows overwrites what WinMarchy sets at the next sign-in.
effects.wallpaperLocked: The wallpaper must not be changed.
effects.colorsLocked: Colours and theme are locked. Light, dark and the Windows accent colour stay as IT sets them.
effects.accentForced: IT sets the Windows accent colour ({value}).
effects.lockScreenLocked: The lock screen must not be changed.
effects.lockScreenOff: The lock screen is switched off.
effects.spotlight: Windows Spotlight is off by policy.
effects.taskbarLocked: Taskbar settings are locked. Hiding the taskbar may fail.
effects.winKeys: Windows' own Win shortcuts are off. WinMarchy's still work.
effects.allowList: Only approved programs may start. GlazeWM, AutoHotkey and Zebar must be on the list.
effects.blockList: Some programs are blocked. If one of WinMarchy's is on the list, it does not start.
effects.appLocker: AppLocker is set up. Programs in C:\WinMarchy\Tools may need approval.
effects.srp: Software restriction policies are active. Programs in C:\WinMarchy\Tools may be blocked.
effects.runIgnored: The user's autostart entries are ignored.
effects.scriptHost: Windows Script Host is off. Start menu and autostart shortcuts cannot be created.
effects.powershell: PowerShell scripts only run under the policy “{value}”.
effects.lockWorkstation: Locking is switched off. Win+Ctrl+L does nothing.
effects.taskManager: Task Manager is blocked. Win+Shift+T opens nothing.
effects.registryTools: The registry editor is blocked. WinMarchy still writes to HKEY_CURRENT_USER.
effects.notifications: The notification center is switched off.
effects.webView2: IT has WebView2 settings. The bar (Zebar) runs on WebView2.
effects.proxy: A proxy is set ({value}). Downloads from GitHub go through it.
effects.proxyScript: A proxy script is set ({value}). Downloads from GitHub go through it.
effects.mdm: The PC is managed through {value} (Intune or another MDM). Such settings are not always in the registry.
